name: lcmp
description: Lebanon Contracting Management Platform - bilingual construction & contracting management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
